name: Matsuzawa Sayaka
source:
A 3rd year student at Kirigaoka Gakuin High School and a member of the gardening club who regularly cares for the school's flowerbeds. Although Sayaka is introverted, short-spoken, and shy, she has a good relationship with Principal Chitose through the of the gardening club's activities. 

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
